A figure and its split-out variants, pooled one first

Source: R/report.R
pooled_then_split.Rd

WHY THIS EXISTS RATHER THAN ONE list.files() PATTERN. Sorting cannot be left to the locale here. R collates through the platform's collation order, which on the usual locales ignores punctuation when comparing – so "umap_markers_d0.png" and "umap_markers.png" compare as "umapmarkersd0png" against "umapmarkerspng", and the day figure sorts FIRST. The section descriptions tell the reader to take the pooled view before the split ones, and a tab strip that opens on d0 contradicts that on the first click.

Usage

pooled_then_split(outdir, stem, suffix = "_[A-Za-z0-9]+")

Arguments

outdir

the results directory.

stem

filename stem, e.g. "umap_markers".

suffix

regex for the split variants' suffix, after the stem and any _panel_N. Defaults to any single alphanumeric run.

Value

filenames present in outdir: pooled first, then the split ones.

Details

The split figures are then ordered by the number inside the suffix rather than as text, so a d10 visit follows d7 instead of landing between d0 and d3.
